articles.Summary: NIPCO and NNPC have announced a new pipeline intended to supply cheaper energy to factories in Ogun State. The development is an infrastructure investment rather than a change in corporate ownership.

articles.Summary: Zichis Agro-Allied Industries Plc joined the Nigerian Exchange in January 2026 with a market value of N1.09 billion. The stock later surged over 700%, then crashed, and attracted a major investor, according to Nairametrics.

articles.Title: NNPC probes Lagos filling station fire that destroyed seven classrooms
articles.Summary: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company (NNPC) is investigating a fire at a Lagos filling station that destroyed seven classrooms. The blaze also destroyed three fuel dispensing pumps, a DAF truck and a Toyota Camry, and damaged electrical appliances in the affected classrooms.

articles.Summary: Seventeen Ministries, Departments and Agencies (MDAs) failed to meet the federal government's benchmark in the 2026 Fiscal Responsibility Index. The article headline reports the shortfall but the available text does not name the agencies or give scores.

articles.Title: Lasaco Assurance gets one-year extension to meet NGX free float requirement
articles.Summary: Lasaco Assurance Plc has secured a one‑year extension from NGX RegCo to meet the exchange’s free float requirement, giving the insurer until 2 November 2027 to bring its free float to the mandated 20% of issued shares or a N20 billion market cap. The extension follows a sharp reduction in accumulated losses, but the firm still faces a negative retained earnings balance at the parent level.

articles.Title: Zamfara among eight states that fully cleared inherited pension backlogs – PenCom report
articles.Summary: On 10 November 2026 PenCom announced that Zamfara State had fully met its inherited pension obligations, joining seven other states that cleared similar backlogs. Governor Dauda Lawal credited President Tinubu’s fiscal reforms for the state’s improved capacity to settle retirees’ dues.

articles.Title: UNIJOS becomes Nigeria’s first university with all-female principal leadership - Premium Times Nigeria
articles.Summary: UNIJOS has appointed an all‑female leadership body, becoming the first university in Nigeria led entirely by women. The move marks a milestone for gender representation in the country’s higher‑education sector.

articles.Title: NCAA upgrades Anambra airport fire-fighting facility to Category 7 – Official - Premium Times Nigeria
articles.Summary: The Nigeria Civil Aviation Authority upgraded the fire‑fighting facility at Anambra Airport to Category 7, meeting higher safety standards for aviation operations. The upgrade follows formal regulatory procedures and is mandatory for airports hosting larger aircraft. The move is expected to enhance safety compliance on Nigerian air transport routes.

articles.Summary: Under the Federal Capital Territory Administration, a land cut was approved for the University of Abuja. The decision was made by Wike’s predecessor, David Mark. This allocation will facilitate the university’s expansion within the Abuja city limits.

articles.Summary: The Federal Ministry of Livestock Development denied allegations of irregularities in the purchase of its Abuja headquarters.
